## About

Bhavesh Kumar Parmar is a Cloud Engineer at Shellkode (Feb 2025 – present) and a
B.Tech Computer Science graduate from JIET Jodhpur (2021–2025, GPA 8.8/10,
specialization in Cloud Computing & Distributed Systems). He engineers reliability
for the AI era: CI/CD automation, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes operations,
and AI-driven incident response on AWS.

## Experience highlights

- 99.9% uptime for critical production workloads at Shellkode through proactive monitoring
- 20% AWS cost reduction via automated scaling policies
- Self-healing Kubernetes clusters deployed with ArgoCD GitOps workflows
- 20+ AWS resources provisioned with Terraform (EC2, S3, Lambda, VPC)
- 3+ Kubernetes clusters (Kind, EKS); 10+ applications containerized with Docker and Helm
- Automation tooling in Python, Java, and Bash across 5+ AWS accounts

## Notable projects

- Self-Healing CI/CD: Python log agents + Gemini root-cause analysis + automatic
  corrective PRs. 94.2% downtime reduction, mean time to fix under 2 minutes.
- Anthropic MCP Server: Model Context Protocol server bridging Claude and internal
  enterprise databases on AWS. mTLS v1.3, latency under 150ms.
- AI SRE Command Center: autonomous AWS remediation — CloudWatch alarms trigger
  Lambda, SSM diagnostics, Gemini-suggested fixes, real-time WebSocket dashboard.
  Mean time to restore under 3 minutes.
